heightEnrichment.curatedProfileSource: ATP/ITF/tournament/college and verified tennis player profiles

meta.currentTop100Policy: Latest dated TML ATP Top-100 snapshot on or before today for the live current season; stable player IDs.
meta.top100SeasonPolicy: For completed seasons, use the final TML ATP ranking snapshot published within that calendar year. For the live current season, use the latest available dated snapshot on or before today. Preserve co-ranked players; count rows without stable player IDs separately and exclude them from player-level height calculations. Each cohort is analyzed against match statistics from the same calendar year.
meta.top1000SeasonPolicy: For completed seasons, the full TML Rankings archive CSV is filtered to the exact final-in-year date already used by the Top 100 snapshot. For the live year, the full KickServe ATP CSV official_rank column is used and its Top 100 membership is cross-checked against the unchanged TML Top 100 snapshot. KickServe's daily CSV is free to use with attribution to https://kick-serve.com/data/. Ties are preserved and unresolved IDs are counted separately. Snapshots that do not extend through a selected cutoff are marked unavailable. Group performance always uses match statistics from that same calendar year.

rankingIdentityResolution.policy: Exact normalized live ranking name plus country must match an audited ATP Tour profile ID override. KickServe provider IDs are never treated as ATP/TML IDs.

meta.seasonDefinition: Calendar year in the TML tournament ID; not a rolling 52-week window.
meta.statistics: Hold% = service games won / service games played. Break% = return games won / return games played. Combined = Hold% + Break%.
meta.sampleNote: Ranking tables use ATP Tour-level singles main-draw results. Height-group statistics use the separate heightGroupSeasons scope: ATP Tour main draws plus ATP Challenger main draws and ATP Tour qualifying where the source is available. Results include retirements in W-L; walkovers and no-play defaults are excluded. Retirement match statistics are not used for Hold/Break because the match sample is partial. Missing or inconsistent stat lines contribute results but no service/return games.
meta.environmentNote: TML indoor Yes/No values and equivalent I/O, Boolean and 1/0 encodings are normalized. Unknown hard-court settings stay in All hard but not in Indoor hard or Outdoor hard.
meta.usage: Personal, educational and non-commercial research only. Keep TML-derived assets private and do not redistribute or use commercially. Supplementary biographical heights from Jeff Sackmann / Tennis Abstract are under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; credit Jeff Sackmann and preserve applicable share-alike terms for permitted redistribution.
